description: EOS-RS Flood and Damage Proxy Maps: Libya, Floods, Sep 2023 is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by Earth Observatory of Singapore, Nanyang Technological University. The Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS) created preliminary Flood Proxy Maps (FPM) and Damage Proxy Maps (DPMs) covering Libya due to flash floods triggered by Storm Daniel in September 2023. These maps were derived from synthetic aperture radar images acquired by the Copernicus Sentinel-1 satellites operated by the European Space Agency. Coverage: Libya. The portal files it under the publisher Earth Observatory of Singapore, Nanyang Technological University. Its tags are FOS: Earth and related environmental sciences. The repository dates the deposit 2023; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Non Commercial 4.0 International. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
